<chapter chapterTitle="PSALM 119." osisID="Ps.119" sID="gen616"/> <title type="chapter">PSALM 119.</title>

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv94"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">א ALEPH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv94"/><w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08549">the undefiled</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">who walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">in the law</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">of the <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>undefiled</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternative">perfect</rdg>, or, <rdg type="alternative">sincere</rdg></note>

<w lemma="strong:H0835">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">they that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">his testimonies</w>, <transChange type="added">and that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">him with the whole heart</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H06466" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">They also do</w> <w lemma="strong:H05766">no iniquity</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">they walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in his ways</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H06680" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">Thou hast commanded</w> <transChange type="added">us</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">diligently</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H0305">O that</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w> <w lemma="strong:H03559" morph="strongMorph:TH8735">were directed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy statutes</w>!

<w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">Then shall I not be ashamed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">when I have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto all thy commandments</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">I will praise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03476">thee with uprightness</w> <w lemma="strong:H03824">of heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">when I shall have learned</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">thy righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>thy…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">judgments of thy righteousness</rdg></note>

<w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">thy statutes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">O forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">me not utterly</w>.

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv95"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ב BETH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv95"/><w lemma="strong:H05288">Wherewithal shall a young man</w> <w lemma="strong:H02135" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">cleanse</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">his way</w>? <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">by taking heed</w> <transChange type="added">thereto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01697">according to thy word</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H03820">With my whole heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I sought</w> <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">thee: O let me not wander</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">from thy commandments</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H0565">Thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H06845" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I hid</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">in mine heart</w>, <w lemma="strong:H02398" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">that I might not sin</w> against thee.

<w lemma="strong:H01288" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">Blessed</w> <transChange type="added">art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03068">thou, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H08193">With my lips</w> <w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">all the judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">of thy mouth</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H07797" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have rejoiced</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">in the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">of thy testimonies</w>, as <transChange type="added">much as</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05921">in</w> <w lemma="strong:H01952">all riches</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">in thy precepts</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and have respect</w> <w lemma="strong:H0734">unto thy ways</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">I will delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H02708">myself in thy statutes</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will not forget</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy word</w>.

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv96"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ג GIMEL.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv96"/><w lemma="strong:H01580" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Deal bountifully</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w>, <transChange type="added">that</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I may live</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy word</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H01540" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Open</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">thou mine eyes</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05027" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">that I may behold</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">wondrous things</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">out of thy law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Open</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Reveal</rdg></note>

I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01616">a stranger</w> <w lemma="strong:H0776">in the earth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H05641" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">hide</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">not thy commandments</w> from me.

<w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01638" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">breaketh</w> <w lemma="strong:H08375">for the longing</w> <transChange type="added">that it hath</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H04941">unto thy judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H06256">at all times</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H01605" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast rebuked</w> <w lemma="strong:H02086">the proud</w> <transChange type="added">that are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H0779" morph="strongMorph:TH8803">cursed</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07686" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">which do err</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">from thy commandments</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H01556" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">from me reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H0937">and contempt</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">thy testimonies</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H08269">Princes</w> <w lemma="strong:H03427" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">also did sit</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8738">speak</w> against me: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05650">thy servant</w> <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">did meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">in thy statutes</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H05713">Thy testimonies</w> also <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08191">my delight</w> <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06098 strong:H0582">my counsellors</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>my counsellors</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">men of my counsel</rdg></note>

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv97"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ד DALETH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv97"/><w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">cleaveth</w> <w lemma="strong:H06083">unto the dust</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou me according to thy word</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H05608" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I have declared</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and thou heardest</w> <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">me: teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make me to understand</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">of thy precepts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">so shall I talk</w> <w lemma="strong:H06381" morph="strongMorph:TH8737">of thy wondrous works</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H05315">My soul</w> <w lemma="strong:H01811" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">melteth</w> <w lemma="strong:H08424">for heaviness</w>: <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">strengthen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thou me according unto thy word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>melteth</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">droppeth</rdg></note>

<w lemma="strong:H05493" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Remove</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">from me the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H08267">of lying</w>: <w lemma="strong:H08451">and grant me thy law</w> <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">graciously</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H0977" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have chosen</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H0530">of truth</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H07737" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have I laid</w> <transChange type="added">before me</transChange>.

<w lemma="strong:H01692" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have stuck</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">unto thy testimonies</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">put me not to shame</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H07323" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will run</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">when thou shalt enlarge</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w>.

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv98"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ה HE.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv98"/><w lemma="strong:H03384" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01870">the way</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">of thy statutes</w>; <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I shall keep</w> it <transChange type="added">unto</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H06118">the end</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H0995" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Give me understanding</w>, <w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I shall keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>; <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">yea, I shall observe</w> it with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">whole heart</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H01869" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Make me to go</w> <w lemma="strong:H05410">in the path</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">of thy commandments</w>; <w lemma="strong:H02654" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for therein do I delight</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Incline</w> <w lemma="strong:H03820">my heart</w> <w lemma="strong:H05715">unto thy testimonies</w>, <w lemma="strong:H01215">and not to covetousness</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H05869">mine eyes</w> <w lemma="strong:H07200" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">from beholding</w> <w lemma="strong:H07723">vanity</w>; <transChange type="added">and</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">thou me in thy way</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>Turn…</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">Make to pass</rdg></note>

<w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Stablish</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>, who <transChange type="added">is devoted</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03374">to thy fear</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H05674" morph="strongMorph:TH8685">Turn away</w> <w lemma="strong:H02781">my reproach</w> <w lemma="strong:H03025" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I fear</w>: <w lemma="strong:H04941">for thy judgments</w> <transChange type="added">are</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02896">good</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H08373" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Behold, I have longed</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">after thy precepts</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">quicken</w> <w lemma="strong:H06666">me in thy righteousness</w>.

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv99"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ו VAU.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv99"/><w lemma="strong:H02617">Let thy mercies</w> <w lemma="strong:H0935" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">come</w> <w lemma="strong:H03068">also unto me, O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <transChange type="added">even</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H08668">thy salvation</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0565">according to thy word</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H01697">So shall I have wherewith</w> <w lemma="strong:H06030" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">to answer</w> <w lemma="strong:H02778" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">him that reproacheth</w> <w lemma="strong:H0982" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">me: for I trust</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">in thy word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>So…</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternative">So shall I answer him that reproveth me in a thing</rdg></note>

<w lemma="strong:H05337" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">And take</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">not the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H0571">of truth</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">utterly</w> <w lemma="strong:H06310">out of my mouth</w>; <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">for I have hoped</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">in thy judgments</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">So shall I keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w> <w lemma="strong:H08548">continually</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">for ever</w> <w lemma="strong:H05703">and ever</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H01980" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">And I will walk</w> <w lemma="strong:H07342">at liberty</w>: <w lemma="strong:H01875" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">for I seek</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>at liberty</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">at large</rdg></note>

<w lemma="strong:H01696" morph="strongMorph:TH8762">I will speak</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">of thy testimonies</w> <w lemma="strong:H04428">also before kings</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0954" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and will not be ashamed</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H08173" morph="strongMorph:TH8698">And I will delight</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">myself in thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have loved</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H03709">My hands</w> <w lemma="strong:H05375" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">also will I lift up</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">unto thy commandments</w>, <w lemma="strong:H0157" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">which I have loved</w>; <w lemma="strong:H07878" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and I will meditate</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">in thy statutes</w>.

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv100"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ז ZAIN.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv100"/><w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">Remember</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">the word</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">unto thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03176" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">upon which thou hast caused me to hope</w>.

This <transChange type="added">is</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05165">my comfort</w> <w lemma="strong:H06040">in my affliction</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0565">for thy word</w> <w lemma="strong:H02421" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">hath quickened</w> me.

<w lemma="strong:H02086">The proud</w> <w lemma="strong:H03966">have had me greatly</w> <w lemma="strong:H03887" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">in derision</w>: <transChange type="added">yet</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H05186" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">have I not declined</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">from thy law</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">thy judgments</w> <w lemma="strong:H05769">of old</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>; <w lemma="strong:H05162" morph="strongMorph:TH8691">and have comforted</w> myself.

<w lemma="strong:H02152">Horror</w> <w lemma="strong:H0270" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">hath taken hold</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">upon me because of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05800" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">that forsake</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.
<w lemma="strong:H02706">Thy statutes</w> <w lemma="strong:H02158">have been my songs</w> <w lemma="strong:H01004">in the house</w> <w lemma="strong:H04033">of my pilgrimage</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H02142" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have remembered</w> <w lemma="strong:H08034">thy name</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H03915">in the night</w>, <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">and have kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.
<w lemma="strong:H05341" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">This I had, because I kept</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv101"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ח CHETH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv101"/><transChange type="added">Thou art</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02506">my portion</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>: <w lemma="strong:H0559" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have said</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">that I would keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H01697">thy words</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H02470" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I intreated</w> <w lemma="strong:H06440">thy favour</w> with <transChange type="added">my</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03820">whole heart</w>: <w lemma="strong:H02603" morph="strongMorph:TH8798">be merciful</w> <w lemma="strong:H0565">unto me according to thy word</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>favour</catchWord>: Heb. <rdg type="x-literal">face</rdg></note>

<w lemma="strong:H02803" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">I thought</w> <w lemma="strong:H01870">on my ways</w>, <w lemma="strong:H07725" morph="strongMorph:TH8686">and turned</w> <w lemma="strong:H07272">my feet</w> <w lemma="strong:H05713">unto thy testimonies</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H02363" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I made haste</w>, <w lemma="strong:H04102" morph="strongMorph:TH8701">and delayed</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8800">not to keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H02256">The bands</w> <w lemma="strong:H07563">of the wicked</w> <w lemma="strong:H05749" morph="strongMorph:TH8765">have robbed</w> me: <transChange type="added">but</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H07911" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">I have not forgotten</w> <w lemma="strong:H08451">thy law</w>.<note type="study"><catchWord>bands</catchWord>: or, <rdg type="alternative">companies</rdg></note>

<w lemma="strong:H03915 strong:H02676">At midnight</w> <w lemma="strong:H06965" morph="strongMorph:TH8799">I will rise</w> <w lemma="strong:H03034" morph="strongMorph:TH8687">to give thanks</w> <w lemma="strong:H06664">unto thee because of thy righteous</w> <w lemma="strong:H04941">judgments</w>.

I <transChange type="added">am</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H02270">a companion</w> of all <transChange type="added">them</transChange> <w lemma="strong:H03372" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">that fear</w> <w lemma="strong:H08104" morph="strongMorph:TH8802">thee, and of them that keep</w> <w lemma="strong:H06490">thy precepts</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H0776">The earth</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H04390" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">is full</w> <w lemma="strong:H02617">of thy mercy</w>: <w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02706">me thy statutes</w>.

<div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv102"/><title canonical="true" type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">ט TETH.</foreign></title> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv102"/><w lemma="strong:H06213" morph="strongMorph:TH8804">Thou hast dealt</w> <w lemma="strong:H02896">well</w> <w lemma="strong:H05650">with thy servant</w>, <w lemma="strong:H03068">O <divineName>Lord</divineName></w>, <w lemma="strong:H01697">according unto thy word</w>.

<w lemma="strong:H03925" morph="strongMorph:TH8761">Teach</w> <w lemma="strong:H02898">me good</w> <w lemma="strong:H02940">judgment</w> <w lemma="strong:H01847">and knowledge</w>: <w lemma="strong:H0539" morph="strongMorph:TH8689">for I have believed</w> <w lemma="strong:H04687">thy commandments</w>.
